_comment: Known race starting-grid penalties. 'places' drops a driver from each predicted/simulated qualifying result; 'back_of_grid' fixes them behind the field. Qualifying fantasy points remain based on the unpenalized qualifying result.

12._note: Belgian GP confirmed penalties before FP3: HAD starts at the back; NOR and STR receive 10-place drops.

13._note: Hungarian GP confirmed post-qualifying penalties: HAM and ANT receive three-place grid drops.

15._note: Italian GP confirmed pre-qualifying penalties: ANT and ALB start from the back of the grid regardless of qualifying position.

18._note: Updated 2026-10-02 for Bahrain GP in Malaysia power-unit changes: Colapinto receives 15 places total (five from the Baku restart collision plus ten for a new engine); Hadjar receives five places; Lindblad receives 30 places and starts at the back of the grid. Sources: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/colapinto-hit-with-five-place-grid-penalty-for-bahrain-gp-in-malaysia-after-baku-collision.3gWVfzDMMr5hReiwTt1fPD ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-17/ ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-18/ ; https://gp.news/documents/2026-bahrain-grand-prix-doc-19/
